summary: Cursor subsystem initialization: configures the frustum viewport to the full screen using the stored screen dimensions, loads four cursor image files through the image-loader/with-handle-storage routine, selects cursor index 0 as the active cursor, and returns 0. Called once from HWInput_Enter when the input device is entered.

operations.description: Set up the frustum viewport for the full screen using the stored dimensions minus one: FrustumViewportSetup(0, 0, dword_8B8DD4 - 1, dword_8B8DD8 - 1).
Load cursor image 0 from the aCursor00Cur file string and store its handle.
Load cursor image 1 from the aCursor01Cur file string and store its handle.
Load cursor image 2 from the aCursor02Cur file string and store its handle.
Load cursor image 3 from the aCursor03Cur file string and store its handle.
Select the active cursor from the loaded array by index 0 via CursorSelectorFromArray(0).
Return 0 after all cursor and viewport initialization steps complete.

unresolved: Which cursor image each aCursor00Cur..aCursor03Cur file corresponds to is not established by this function; only the file strings are consumed.
The exact meaning of dword_8B8DD4 / dword_8B8DD8 (screen dimensions) is DERIVED from prior analysis, not proven by this source text.
